greptile.text: Summarizes the PR as converting destinationCalendar from a single object to an array across the calendar code, using the first element as the main host calendar. It notes the createEvent signature gains a credentialId parameter. It flags risks from unvalidated non-empty array assumptions, a duplicated database query inside a loop in EventManager, and incomplete handling of empty arrays. Confidence score: 2/5.
Style note: the optional chaining on mainHostDestinationCalendar?.integration is redundant because the ternary already checks mainHostDestinationCalendar. Suggests removing the ?. operator.
Logic error: when externalCalendarId is provided, the find searches for cal.externalId === externalCalendarId, which will not work as intended. Suggests finding by credentialId or different logic.
Same logic error as the updateEvent case: matching cal.externalId against externalCalendarId in the fallback lookup will not work as intended.
Style note: the pattern of taking the first destinationCalendar element with a ?? [] fallback is repeated twice in this file. Suggests extracting it into a helper function.

Logic note: mainHostDestinationCalendar may be undefined when the array is empty, so the integration check could throw. Suggests using optional chaining (?.integration) in the google_calendar comparison.
Logic note: destination.externalId is passed as a third argument to createEvent, but the fallback call omits it, so usage is inconsistent.
